new_result.name: arbitrary-offset graphical inverse-gap localization
new_result.statement: For any fixed finite simple graph with edge exponents theta_e, the pair-gap moment with arbitrary real edge offsets is uniformly finite over all independent cap-one input densities iff every vertex cluster S has internal exponent sum strictly below |S|-1. The offsets need not be cycle-consistent.
new_result.proof_mechanism: scale exponents into the graphic-matroid independent-set polytope; convex-decompose into forests; dominate by truncated near-gap kernels; apply Holder across the forest mixture; eliminate leaves using a translation-uniform one-dimensional cap-one bound

peers_applied.scope: global convex-mixture localization, allowing component-adaptive bounded-size graph certificates to transfer to arbitrary supports
independent arbitrary-offset triangle theorem, consistent with and subsumed by the new graph theorem
translation-uniform three-coordinate curved coarea; supplies the live reciprocal-kernel synthesis target

first_unproved_step: Convert the prebound determinant/Pluecker-weighted curved-coarea reciprocal kernel into a convex combination of uniformly bounded-size arbitrary-offset pair-gap graphs with uniform positive cluster slack, or prove a critical collision cluster is unavoidable.
